leads.reason: Registered as 'Insieme omogeneo di Cedrus libani' (a homogeneous group). MuseoFerrara/local press describe three cedars of Lebanon at the Parco Massari entrance, probably dating to 1885, on Italy's first monumental tree list alongside the park's bagolaro (shipped as fer_002). Not a single collectible point as registered; worth a future look at whether one specimen can be split out and individually named.
